Privacy Notice for Appdaemon (Smartotum)


Who is the Data Controller?

This application is managed through the Privacy Dashboard by the Primary Data Controller (owner) of the application. Contact details and, if applicable, the appointed Data Protection Officer (DPO) are available in the dashboard.


What is Appdaemon?

Appdaemon is a local automation runtime deployed in a Smartotum smart home. It executes user-defined automation scripts triggered by home events (e.g., sensors, device state changes, schedules) and can issue commands to devices through Smartotum controllers.


What data is processed?

  • Device identifiers and metadata (UUIDs, device types, room/area references)
  • Automation configuration (scripts, schedules, thresholds)
  • Operational events and logs (timestamps, triggers executed, action outcomes, error messages)
  • Optional: presence/occupancy signals, only if enabled by the configured automations


Why do we process this data?

  • To provide the home automation service requested by the user
  • To support safety and comfort through user-defined automations (e.g., alerts, scheduled actions)
  • To ensure reliability and security via troubleshooting and limited operational logging
  • To enforce privacy choices through policies created in the Privacy Dashboard


Legal basis

  • Service provision (necessary processing for core automation features)
  • Legitimate interests for security, diagnostics, and incident investigation (with limited retention)
  • Consent for optional processing beyond what is necessary, where applicable, which can be withdrawn at any time


Recipients and sharing

By default, data is processed locally within the smart home environment and the Privacy Dashboard. No third-party sharing is performed unless explicitly configured and documented.


Retention

  • Configuration: retained until changed or until the application is removed
  • Operational logs: retained for a limited period (e.g., 30 days) and rotated
  • Backups (if enabled): retained for a limited period (e.g., 30 days)


Security measures

  • Authentication and role-based access control in the Privacy Dashboard
  • Encrypted transport (HTTPS/TLS) for API access
  • Local-first deployment recommendations (regular updates and network isolation)


Your rights

You can exercise your rights (access, rectification, erasure, restriction, objection, portability, and withdrawal of consent) through the Privacy Dashboard. Requests are handled by the responsible Data Controller or DPO.


Updates

This Privacy Notice may be updated when the processing changes. Last updated: 2026-03-03.
